description: Ranking configuration. Every number the ranker uses lives here, not in code, so tuning is a reviewable config change rather than a code change.

requestAware.comment: Multipliers applied when the student states a preference explicitly. Weights are renormalised afterwards, so a boost shifts share rather than inflating the total.

missingDataPolicy.comment: REDISTRIBUTE: a feature with no data is dropped and its weight is shared among the features that do have data. Never substitute a neutral or zero value — that would be inventing an observation. The loss of evidence is reported separately as dataCoverage.

credentialScale.comment: Maps a domain's headline score onto [0,1]. Floors are the level below which a mentor is not meaningfully stronger for teaching purposes.

sectionScale.comment: Per-skill score scales. HSK has no per-skill scores in V1, so HSK focus skills score on teaching evidence alone.

focusSkill.comment: How a single focus skill is scored when a per-skill band exists. When it does not, the taught signal carries the feature alone.

experience.comment: Saturating: the difference between 0 and 20 sessions matters far more than between 200 and 220. rate is the exponential constant in 1 - exp(-rate * x).

rating.comment: Ratings cluster near the top, so the usable range starts at 3.0 rather than 0.

budget.comment: Headroom under the stated budget. A mentor priced exactly at the maximum is affordable but has no headroom, so they score floorAtMax rather than 0.

explanation.comment: Caps on how much is said per recommendation. Reasons are ordered by the weight of the feature they come from, so a cap drops the least relevant facts first, never the most.
